_comment: Pre-screen input: fresh macro/pre-market conditions + per-stock news, from reliable sources. NEWS GOES STALE - refresh before relying on it. To refresh: web-search current futures/VIX/yields/oil + headlines and each stock's latest news, then rewrite this file with today's date, numbers, and source links. prescreen.py and overall.py read this; they do NOT fetch news themselves. Trigger keyword: Pre-screen.

macro.summary: Cautious pre-open for Fri 2026-06-26, a PCE-inflation morning. Overnight was sharply risk-off in Asia (Nikkei -4.2%, KOSPI -5.8%, Hang Seng -1.8%) and Europe is soft (DAX -1.1%, FTSE -0.8%). US index futures are roughly flat ahead of the May core PCE print (the Fed's preferred gauge, key after the hawkish Warsh meeting). The VIX has jumped to ~20 (+6%) and VVIX ~91, but Treasuries catch a safe-haven bid (10y 4.40%, 2y 4.09%, both a touch lower) and the dollar eases (DXY 101.0). Net: defensive into the data.
